label: Fire
description: Fire damage is delivered by heat and flame, whether mundane or magical (e.g. red dragon breath, Fire Bolt).

label: Cold
description: Cold damage is delivered by ice, freezing vapor, and other numbing, frostbite-inducing effects.

label: Acid
description: Acid damage is delivered by corrosive substances and dissolving attacks (e.g. black dragon breath, some oozes).

label: Lightning
description: Lightning damage is delivered by raw electrical energy (e.g. blue dragon breath, Lightning Bolt).

label: Thunder
description: Thunder damage is delivered by concussive sound and vibratory force (e.g. Thunderwave).

label: Poison
description: Poison damage is delivered by venom, toxic gas, and other caustic or biological toxins.

label: Radiant
description: Radiant damage is searing light and holy or celestial power (e.g. Moonbeam, a deva's weapon).

label: Necrotic
description: Necrotic damage withers life, flesh, and souls—often from undeath, decay, or void-like magic.

label: Force
description: Force damage is pure magical energy, forming invisible walls and unerring blasts (e.g. Magic Missile).

label: Psychic
description: Psychic damage assails the mind, emotions, and sanity (e.g. mind flayer attacks, Dissonant Whispers).
